How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.
How dark has the gold become! how changed the best gold! the stones of the holy place are dropping out at the top of every street.
黃金何其失光！純金何其變色！聖所的石頭倒在各市口上。
How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
The valued sons of Zion, whose price was the best gold, are looked on as vessels of earth, the work of the hands of the potter!
錫安寶貴的眾子好比精金，現在何竟算為窯匠手所做的瓦瓶？
Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
Even the beasts of the waste land have full breasts, they give milk to their young ones: the daughter of my people has become cruel like the ostriches in the waste land.
野狗尚且把奶乳哺其子，我民的婦人倒成為殘忍，好像曠野的鴕鳥一般。
The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth. Little children beg for bread, but no one gives them any.
The tongue of the child at the breast is fixed to the roof of his mouth for need of drink: the young children are crying out for bread, and no man gives it to them.
吃奶孩子的舌頭因乾渴貼住上膛；孩童求餅，無人擘給他們。
Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets; those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps.
Those who were used to feasting on delicate food are wasted in the streets: those who as children were dressed in purple are stretched out on the dust.
素來吃美好食物的，現今在街上變為孤寒；素來臥朱紅褥子的，現今躺臥糞堆。
The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her.
For the punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of Sodom, which was overturned suddenly without any hand falling on her.
都因我眾民的罪孽比所多瑪的罪還大；所多瑪雖然無人加手於她，還是轉眼之間被傾覆。
Her dignitaries were brighter than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.
Her holy ones were cleaner than snow, they were whiter than milk, their bodies were redder than corals, their form was as the sapphire:
錫安的貴冑素來比雪純淨，比奶更白；他們的身體比紅寶玉（或譯：珊瑚）更紅，像光潤的藍寶石一樣。
But now their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
Their face is blacker than night; in the streets no one has knowledge of them: their skin is hanging on their bones, they are dry, they have become like wood.
現在他們的面貌比煤炭更黑，以致在街上無人認識；他們的皮膚緊貼骨頭，枯乾如同槁木。
Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.
Those who have been put to the sword are better off than those whose death is caused by need of food; for these come to death slowly, burned up like the fruit of the field.
餓死的不如被刀殺的，因為這是缺了田間的土產，就身體衰弱，漸漸消滅。
The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
The hands of kind-hearted women have been boiling their children; they were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
慈悲的婦人，當我眾民被毀滅的時候，親手煮自己的兒女作為食物。
The LORD has exhausted His wrath; He has poured out His fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has consumed her foundations.
The Lord has given full effect to his passion, he has let loose his burning wrath; he has made a fire in Zion, causing the destruction of its bases.
耶和華發怒成就他所定的，倒出他的烈怒；在錫安使火著起，燒毀錫安的根基。
The kings of the earth did not believe, nor any people of the world, that an enemy or a foe could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
To the kings of the earth and to all the people of the world it did not seem possible that the attackers and the haters would go into the doors of Jerusalem.
地上的君王和世上的居民都不信敵人和仇敵能進耶路撒冷的城門。
But this was for the sins of her prophets and the guilt of her priests, who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst.
It is because of the sins of her prophets and the evil-doing of her priests, by whom the blood of the upright has been drained out in her.
這都因她先知的罪惡和祭司的罪孽；他們在城中流了義人的血。
They wandered blind in the streets, defiled by this blood, so that no one dared to touch their garments.
They are wandering like blind men in the streets, they are made unclean with blood, so that their robes may not be touched by men.
他們在街上如瞎子亂走，又被血玷污，以致人不能摸他們的衣服。
“Go away! Unclean!” men shouted at them. “Away, away! Do not touch us!” So they fled and wandered. Among the nations it was said, “They can stay here no longer.”
Away! unclean! they were crying out to them, Away! away! let there be no touching: when they went away in flight and wandering, men said among the nations, There is no further resting-place for them.
人向他們喊著說：不潔淨的，躲開，躲開！不要挨近我！他們逃走飄流的時候，列國中有人說：他們不可仍在這裡寄居。
The presence of the LORD has scattered them; He regards them no more. The priests are shown no honor; the elders find no favor.
The face of the Lord has sent them in all directions; he will no longer take care of them: they had no respect for the priests, they gave no honour to the old men.
耶和華發怒，將他們分散，不再眷顧他們；人不重看祭司，也不厚待長老。
All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.
Our eyes are still wasting away in looking for our false help: we have been watching for a nation unable to give salvation.
我們仰望人來幫助，以致眼目失明，還是枉然；我們所盼望的，竟盼望一個不能救人的國！
They stalked our every step, so that we could not walk in our streets. Our end drew near, our time ran out, for our end had come!
They go after our steps so that we may not go in our streets: our end is near, our days are numbered; for our end has come.
仇敵追趕我們的腳步像打獵的，以致我們不敢在自己的街上行走。我們的結局臨近；我們的日子滿足；我們的結局來到了。
Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky; they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness.
Those who went after us were quicker than the eagles of the heaven, driving us before them on the mountains, waiting secretly for us in the waste land.
追趕我們的比空中的鷹更快；他們在山上追逼我們，在曠野埋伏，等候我們。
The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits. We had said of him, “Under his shadow we will live among the nations.”
Our breath of life, he on whom the holy oil was put, was taken in their holes; of whom we said, Under his shade we will be living among the nations.
耶和華的受膏者好比我們鼻中的氣，在他們的坑中被捉住；我們曾論到他說：我們必在他蔭下，在列國中存活。
So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz. Yet the cup will pass to you as well; you will get drunk and expose yourself.
Have joy and be glad, O daughter of Edom, living in the land of Uz: the cup will be given to you in your turn, and you will be overcome with wine and your shame will be seen.
住烏斯地的以東民哪，只管歡喜快樂；苦杯也必傳到你那裡；你必喝醉，以致露體。
O Daughter of Zion, your punishment is complete; He will not prolong your exile. But He will punish your iniquity, O Daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins.

The punishment of your evil-doing is complete, O daughter of Zion; never again will he take you away as a prisoner: he will give you the reward of your evil-doing, O daughter of Edom; he will let your sin be uncovered.
錫安的民哪，你罪孽的刑罰受足了，耶和華必不使你再被擄去。以東的民哪，他必追討你的罪孽，顯露你的罪惡。
